Generated Narrative: ValueSet fiji-condition-code-vs

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where constraint = < 404684003 AND ^ 816080008
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where constraint = < 243796009 AND ^ 816080008
  • Include all codes defined in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-am version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)

name: FijiConditionCodeVS
title: Condition/Diagnosis code valueset
description:
Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary.
Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".
